title: Robotic-supported Data Loss Detection in Android Applications
abstract: arXiv:2610.20807v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Smartphones have become integral to modern life due to their diverse applications. However, the development of applications for these devices faces significant challenges, primarily due to two factors: (i) the diverse hardware and operating system versions that require testing across multiple configurations; and (ii) the imperative activity of testing the smartphone in a non-invasive way (similar to an end-user interaction), which is expensive, tedious and error-prone as it is usually carried out manually. In this context, robotic automation has emerged as an effective solution for addressing the diversity of smartphone systems and versions, and in performing some testing tasks non-invasively. In addition, automated robots facilitate quick, accurate, and repetitive testing, thus enabling developers to validate their applications across various configurations effectively. translated_title: 机器人支持的安卓应用数据丢失检测
translated_abstract: 智能手机因其多样化的应用已成为现代生活中不可或缺的一部分。然而，为这些设备开发应用程序面临重大挑战，主要源于两个因素：(i) 多样化的硬件和操作系统版本需要在多种配置下进行测试；(ii) 以非侵入方式（类似终端用户交互）测试智能手机的必要性，这种方式通常由人工执行，成本高、枯燥乏味且容易出错。在此背景下，机器人自动化已成为应对智能手机系统和版本多样性的有效解决方案，并能以非侵入的方式执行某些测试任务。此外，自动化机器人便于进行快速、准确且可重复的测试，从而使开发人员能够在各种配置下有效地验证其应用程序。这使得验证过程的侵入性更低，并带来显著的……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出利用机器人自动化技术以非侵入方式检测安卓应用中的数据丢失问题，从而高效应对多样化硬件与操作系统配置下的应用测试挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using robotic automation to detect data loss in Android applications in a non-invasive manner, effectively addressing testing challenges across diverse hardware and OS configurations.
